history.origins: Vira is Sweden's national card game and the most elaborate of the Solo family (with Solo Whist and Préférence). Tradition holds it was invented around 1810 at Vira courthouse when a storm snowbound the court; two Walloon gentlemen are said to have devised it. It was the most advanced and popular card game in Sweden for a long time; popularity declined after Contract Bridge arrived in the early 1930s because Vira never became standardized like Skat.

rules.objective: The highest bidder becomes the declarer and plays alone against the other two. The declarer must either take at least a stated number of tricks or, in misery contracts, lose every trick; the defenders try to prevent the declarer from making the contract.
